body:
Ah yes, that's right it is available in `npm run dev` as well. I thought it would come packaged with the custom `app.js`. My bad.

Not sure if you want to keep using `dev` and document that we can access the generated `instantsearch.js` from here, or use a new command that only expose the `instantsearch.js` (without the playground).

Another thing to note is that by using `http-server` to serve the directory instead of webpack, it now uses available ports (starting from `8080`). This helps a lot when you have multiple projects, all using the `8080` port.
